<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Auliverse | A Origem da Luz</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --gold: #c9a84c;
    --gold-light: #e8c97a;
    --gold-dim: rgba(201,168,76,0.15);
    --void: #050507;
    --mist: #0e0e14;
    --text: #d4cfc8;
    --text-dim: rgba(212,207,200,0.5);
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    background: var(--void);
    color: var(--text);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: default;
  }

  /* ── NOISE OVERLAY ── */
  body::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1000;
    opacity: 0.35;
  }

  /* ── NAV ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    padding: 24px 48px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(5,5,7,0.9), transparent);
  }

  .nav-logo {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 36px;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .nav-links a {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }

  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Orb background */
  .hero::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 10%; right: -10%;
    width: 70vw; height: 70vw;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center,
      rgba(201,168,76,0.06) 0%,
      rgba(80,50,120,0.04) 40%,
      transparent 70%);
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: pulse 8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0.8; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.05) rotate(3deg); opacity: 1; }
  }

  .hero-text {
    padding: 140px 64px 80px 80px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    animation: fadeUp 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both;
  }

  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .hero-label {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .hero-label::before {
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    width: 32px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
  }

  h1 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(48px, 6vw, 88px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.0;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    color: #f0ebe2;
  }

  h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    display: block;
  }

  .hero-divider {
    width: 60px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gold), transparent);
    margin: 32px 0;
  }

  .hero-synopsis {
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    max-width: 440px;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .hero-synopsis strong {
    color: var(--text);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  .btn-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 16px 32px;
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #0a0807;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-primary::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: white;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-primary:hover::after { opacity: 0.15; }
  .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(201,168,76,0.3); }

  .btn-secondary {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 15px 32px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid rgba(212,207,200,0.25);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-secondary:hover {
    border-color: var(--gold);
    color: var(--gold);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  /* ── BOOK VISUAL ── */
  .hero-visual {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 140px 80px 80px 40px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    animation: fadeUp 1.2s 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both;
  }

  .book-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    perspective: 1200px;
  }

  .book {
    width: 260px;
    height: 380px;
    position: relative;
    transform-style: preserve-3d;
    transform: rotateY(-18deg) rotateX(4deg);
    filter: drop-shadow(-40px 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.9));
    transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  }

  .book:hover {
    transform: rotateY(-8deg) rotateX(2deg) scale(1.03);
  }

  .book-cover {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0f0d16 0%, #1a1528 40%, #0a0812 100%);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-left: 4px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
  }

  /* Fractal eye SVG pattern */
  .book-cover::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 120px 80px at 50% 38%, rgba(201,168,76,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 200px 200px at 50% 50%, rgba(80,50,140,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
  }

  .book-art {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -52%);
    width: 160px;
    height: 160px;
  }

  /* Animated eye / mind symbol */
  .eye-outer {
    width: 160px; height: 160px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3);
    position: absolute;
    animation: spin 30s linear infinite;
  }
  .eye-mid {
    width: 110px; height: 110px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
    position: absolute;
    top: 25px; left: 25px;
    animation: spin 20s linear infinite reverse;
  }
  .eye-inner {
    width: 64px; height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.5);
    position: absolute;
    top: 48px; left: 48px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,168,76,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .eye-dot {
    width: 10px; height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--gold);
    position: absolute;
    top: 75px; left: 75px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--gold), 0 0 40px rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
    animation: breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes breathe {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
  }

  /* Decorative lines on cover */
  .book-cover::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 120px;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(201,168,76,0.06), transparent);
  }

  .book-title-cover {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 32px;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0 16px;
  }

  .book-title-cover span {
    display: block;
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .book-title-cover small {
    display: block;
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(201,168,76,0.5);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  /* Book spine */
  .book-spine {
    position: absolute;
    left: -22px; top: 0;
    width: 22px; height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #0c0b10, #1a1528);
    transform-origin: right;
    transform: rotateY(-90deg);
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .book-spine span {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(201,168,76,0.5);
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: mixed;
    transform: rotate(180deg);
  }

  /* Glow under book */
  .book-glow {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -40px; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 200px; height: 40px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(201,168,76,0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
    filter: blur(20px);
    animation: breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* Floating particles */
  .particles {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -40px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .particle {
    position: absolute;
    width: 2px; height: 2px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--gold);
    animation: float linear infinite;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  @keyframes float {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0) translateX(0); }
    10% { opacity: 0.8; }
    90% { opacity: 0.4; }
    100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-120px) translateX(var(--drift)); }
  }

  /* ── QUOTE BAND ── */
  .quote-band {
    padding: 64px 80px;
    background: var(--mist);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.1);
    text-align: center;
    animation: fadeUp 1s 0.4s both;
  }

  .quote-band blockquote {
    font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px);
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-width: 800px;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    color: rgba(240,235,226,0.8);
  }

  .quote-band cite {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-style: normal;
  }

  /* ── SECTIONS ── */
  .section {
    padding: 100px 80px;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .section-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
    gap: 80px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .section-inner.reverse { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; }

  .section-label {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .section-label::after {
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    width: 24px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
  }

  h2 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 56px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.1;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: #f0ebe2;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  h2 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold-light);
  }

  .section p {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    max-width: 560px;
  }

  .section p + p { margin-top: 16px; }

  .section-number {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(80px, 12vw, 160px);
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    line-height: 1;
    color: rgba(201,168,76,0.06);
    user-select: none;
    position: sticky;
    top: 80px;
  }

  /* Horizontal rule */
  .hr {
    width: 100%;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(201,168,76,0.15), transparent);
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* ── UNIVERSE SECTION ── */
  .universe {
    padding: 100px 80px;
    background: var(--mist);
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .universe::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    width: 600px; height: 600px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(201,168,76,0.04) 0%, transparent 60%);
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: pulse 12s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .universe h2 { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 24px; }
  .universe p { max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto 48px; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-dim); }

  .universe-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .universe-card {
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.12);
    padding: 36px 28px;
    text-align: left;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    transition: all 0.4s;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .universe-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gold), transparent);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left;
    transition: transform 0.4s;
  }

  .universe-card:hover { border-color: rgba(201,168,76,0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); }
  .universe-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }

  .card-icon {
    font-size: 28px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    display: block;
  }

  .card-title {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .card-desc {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: var(--text-dim);
  }

  /* ── AUTHOR ── */
  .author-section {
    padding: 100px 80px;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 80px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .author-portrait {
    position: relative;
  }

  .author-frame {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 3/4;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0f0d16, #1a1528);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.15);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .author-frame::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 60%, rgba(201,168,76,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
  }

  .author-initials {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 80px;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    color: rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .author-corner {
    position: absolute;
    width: 24px; height: 24px;
    border-color: var(--gold);
    border-style: solid;
    opacity: 0.4;
  }

  .author-corner.tl { top: 16px; left: 16px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; }
  .author-corner.tr { top: 16px; right: 16px; border-width: 1px 1px 0 0; }
  .author-corner.bl { bottom: 16px; left: 16px; border-width: 0 0 1px 1px; }
  .author-corner.br { bottom: 16px; right: 16px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; }

  .author-info { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

  /* ── CTA ── */
  .cta {
    padding: 120px 80px;
    text-align: center;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--void), rgba(201,168,76,0.03), var(--void));
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .cta h2 { font-size: clamp(40px, 5vw, 72px); max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto 20px; }
  .cta p { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-dim); max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 48px; line-height: 1.7; }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer {
    padding: 40px 80px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.1);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .footer-logo {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  footer small {
    font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    color: rgba(212,207,200,0.25);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* ── SCROLL ANIMATIONS ── */
  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    transition: opacity 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  }

  .reveal.visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
  .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
  .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }

  /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    nav { padding: 20px 24px; }
    .nav-links { display: none; }
    .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; }
    .hero-text { padding: 120px 24px 40px; }
    .hero-visual { padding: 20px 24px 60px; }
    .quote-band { padding: 48px 24px; }
    .section { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .section-inner, .section-inner.reverse { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
    .section-number { display: none; }
    .universe { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .universe-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .author-section { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 64px 24px; gap: 40px; }
    .author-frame { aspect-ratio: 4/3; max-width: 320px; }
    .cta { padding: 80px 24px; }
    footer { padding: 32px 24px; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; text-align: center; }
    .book { width: 200px; height: 290px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <div class="nav-logo" style="padding:0;"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
